🆕 New listing (published: November 27, 2026)

The Hanno–Hidaka Rabies Prevention Association is hosting a "Dog Manners & Training Lecture." This class is for people who are having trouble with their dog's behavior, or who are thinking about getting a dog.

【Date and Time】
January 30, 2027 (Saturday), 1:00 p.m.–3:00 p.m. (Reception opens at 12:40 p.m.)

【Venue】
Hidaka City Takahagi Community Center (802-3 Aza-Takahagi, Hidaka City; 10 minutes walk from Musashi-Takahagi Station on the JR Kawagoe Line)

【Instructor】
Shigemi Iriko, Ph.D. (Associate Professor, Tokyo University of Agriculture and Technology; Veterinarian; Diplomate, American College of Veterinary Behaviorists)

【Capacity】
50 people (first-come, first-served; registration closes when capacity is reached)

【Who Can Attend】
People having trouble with their dog's behavior, or people considering getting a dog

【Fee】
Free

【Registration Deadline】
January 8, 2027 (Friday)

【How to Register】
Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m.: apply in person at the Environment and Water Resources Division office (phone: 042-973-2125), by phone, or through the online application system.

【What to Bring】
Nothing in particular. Dogs may not attend or be brought along.

【Parking】
Parking is limited. Please use public transportation.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kankyokeizaibu/kankyomidorimizuka/8724.html
